description: This source file implements credential storage management including parsing, storing, removing, and retrieving credentials from files, primarily used for Git credential operations.

methods.name: int parse_credential_file(const char * fn,struct credential * c,void (* match_cb)(struct credential *),void (* other_cb)(struct strbuf *),int match_password)
methods.description: Parses a credential file line by line, matching credentials against a provided credential and executing callbacks on matches or other lines.

methods.name: void print_entry(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Prints credential details (username and password) to standard output.

methods.name: void print_line(struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Appends a newline to a buffer and writes it to the credential lock file.

methods.name: void rewrite_credential_file(const char * fn,struct credential * c,struct strbuf * extra,int match_password)
methods.description: Rewrites the credential file with optional extra data, handling locking and timeout.

methods.name: int is_rfc3986_unreserved(char ch)
methods.description: Checks if a character is an unreserved character according to RFC 3986.

methods.name: int is_rfc3986_reserved_or_unreserved(char ch)
methods.description: Checks if a character is reserved or unreserved according to RFC 3986.

methods.name: void store_credential_file(const char * fn,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Stores a credential in specified file by URL-encoding its components.

methods.name: void store_credential(const struct string_list * fns,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Stores a credential in one of the specified files after validation.

methods.name: void remove_credential(const struct string_list * fns,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Removes (or overrides) credentials in specified files based on matching criteria.

methods.name: void lookup_credential(const struct string_list * fns,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Looks up and retrieves credentials from specified files.

methods.name: int cmd_credential_store(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main command function handling 'get', 'store', and 'erase' actions for credentials via command line.
